name: King of the Wild Plains
summary: Watcher Cornelius asks you to face the leader of the lion pride near Terral's Watch. He wants its hide, and the matter kept from Demar.

sections.title: A Call for the Pride
sections.body: Watcher Cornelius at Terral's Watch has made a Tallstrider Call for you. He sends you to the hill just north, where the lions gather. Blow the whistle there to draw out the pride's leader, then bring its hide back to Cornelius.

sections.title: Cornelius's Concern
sections.body: Cornelius is satisfied that the lion is slain. He asks you to keep the matter from Demar, saying Demar has already sent him out here and he wants no more attention from him.

faq.q: Who asks me to hunt the lion?
faq.answer: Watcher Cornelius at Terral's Watch asks you to bring him the hide of the lion pride's leader.
The hill where the lions gather is just north of Cornelius at Terral's Watch.
The Tallstrider Call draws out the leader of the lion pride when blown at the hill.

faq.q: What does Cornelius want from the lion?
faq.answer: Cornelius asks you to retrieve the leader's hide.

attribution: In-game quest text: King of the Wild Plains
